主要内容: Katten has expanded its Mergers and Acquisitions/Private Equity team by adding Christopher Isaacs as a partner in New York. Isaacs focuses on asset and equity transactions, joint ventures, reorganizations, and corporate law matters. He has represented private equity funds, asset managers, banks, financial technology firms, and real estate investment firms. Prior to joining Katten, Isaacs was an attorney at Goodwin Procter and an Assistant General Counsel at JPMorgan Chase & Co. The Mergers and Acquisitions/Private Equity practice has added nearly two dozen attorneys over the past year, enhancing its capabilities and market intelligence. Katten is a full-service law firm with 700 attorneys across the U.S., London, and Shanghai, offering services in corporate, financial markets, real estate, and other areas. The firm represents public and private companies, government entities, and nonprofit organizations.
